items.title: In a 2-commutative triangle with a surjective arrow, quasi-compactness of one leg implies quasi-compactness of the other
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that in a 2-commutative triangle of morphisms of algebraic stacks, quasi-compactness of one leg together with surjectivity of the opposite arrow forces quasi-compactness of the remaining leg (author lemma at source lines 2013-2025, label lemma-surjection-from-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 2027-2041) tests the definition of quasi-compactness against an arbitrary quasi-compact stack mapping to the apex, uses that surjectivity survives base change, and concludes with the criterion that quasi-compactness descends along a surjective morphism (proof lines 2028-2039). The verification of the defining property at an arbitrary test object is the content. H2.
